webSearch.title: Ukusesha kweWebhu
webSearch.description: Ilawula ukuthi ukusesha kuwebhu okuphila kusetshenziswa kanjani lapho i-Search Mode ivuliwe. Izinguquko ziyasebenza ngokushesha.
webSearch.providerAutoDescription: Isebenzisa okuzenzakalelayo kokwabiwa — okwamanje isebenzisa ukusesha kwezindaba okuhlanganisiwe ngezansi.
webSearch.providerNewsDescription: Ibuza yomibili imithombo ngasikhathi sinye bese ihlanganisa imiphumela, okwenza noma ingenye ehluleka kungaphazamiseki ukusesha. Ilinganisela kahle isivinini, ukwehluka kwemithombo, namakhasi angasebenza ezindabeni.
webSearch.providerGoogleNewsDescription: Ishesha futhi ayazivezi — kuphela umbuzo wokusesha ofinyelela ku-Google (akukho akhawunti noma amakhukhi) bese imiphumela ifika cishe ngomzuzwana. Qaphela: ikakhulukazi ibheka izihloko nezitatimende ezimfushane, hhayi zonke izindatshana, ngakho izimpendulo zingahlala phezulu.
webSearch.providerGdeltDescription: Idatha evulekile yokucwaninga yezindaba zomhlaba eneziqondiso eziqondile zabanikazi bezindaba, evumela imibuzo elandelayo ukufunda izindatshana ngokugcwele. Ivinjelwe ngokomkhawulo wesilinganiso — ukusesha okuqhubekayo kungalinda imizuzwana embalwa.
webSearch.providerBingDescription: Ifunda amakhasi aphelele ukuthola izifinyezo ezijulile futhi imboza iwebhu iyonke, hhayi izindaba kuphela. Kodwa, ukusesha kuvame ukuthatha imizuzwana engu-30–90 futhi izinga lemiphumela lihluka.
webSearch.sourcesDescription: Imithombo ehlukene eyogcinwa njengoba kushiwo. Imibuzo yesitayela socwaningo ingakwazi ukwandisa leli nani ngokuzenzakalelayo.
webSearch.freshnessDescription: Imiphumela kufanele ibe yamuva kangakanani. Okuzenzakalelayo kuvumela umbuzo ngamunye ukuthi uqoke (izindaba eziphuthumayo zisebenzisa usuku olulodwa).
webSearch.providerCombined: Usesho olujulile nezihloko zokuqala (Bing + Google News)
webSearch.providerCombinedDescription: Isebenzisa i-Bing grounding kanye ne-Google News ngesikhathi esisodwa: izihloko zivele kungakapheli mzuzwana usesho olujulile lwe-Bing luqhubeka, futhi ungakhetha ukuphendula ezihlokweni ngokushesha kunokulinda. Uma i-Bing isiqedile, imiphumela yomibili iyahlanganiswa.
webSearch.providerBingResponsesDescription: Ukusetshenziswa kwewebhu kweBing okufanayo ne-Bing grounding, kodwa kusebenzisa imodeli eyodwa ngokushesha — ngokuvamile kushesha kakhulu. Inketho entsha esahlolwayo uma iqhathaniswa ne-Bing grounding.

settings.exportImportDescription: Landa izingxoxo zakho, amafolda, namaphrompthi njengefayela, noma uwasibonise kusuka kuthunyelwe kwangaphambilini.

createDiagrams.title: Dala Amadayagramu
createDiagrams.prompt: Ngikhombise indlela ongadala ngayo amadayagramu namaflowchathi. Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinqubo, imisebenzi, noma izinhlelo ongangisize ngikubone? Nginike izibonelo.

draftContent.title: Bhala Okuqukethwe Kobuchwepheshe
draftContent.prompt: Ngidinga usizo lokubhala amadokhumenti obuchwepheshe - ama-imeyili, imibiko, izifingqo. Ungangibonisa izibonelo zendlela ongasiza ngayo nezinhlobo ezihlukene zokubhala kwebhizinisi?

analyzeInformation.title: Hlaziya Ulwazi
analyzeInformation.prompt: Ungangisiza kanjani ukuhlaziya idatha noma ulwazi? Ngikhombise izindlela ezihlukene ongahlukanisa ngayo izinombolo, uthole amaphethini, noma ukhiphe ulwazi kumadokhumenti noma amaseti edatha.

planOrganize.title: Hlela & Lungisa
planOrganize.prompt: Ungangisiza ukuhlela amaphrojekthi noma ukulungisa umsebenzi? Nginike izibonelo zendlela ongadala ngayo izikali zesikhathi, izinhlelo zomhlangano, noma izinhlelo zamaphrojekthi ezinamasakhiwo ahlukahlukene.

brainstormIdeas.title: Cabanga Amasu
brainstormIdeas.prompt: Ngifuna ukucabanga izixazululo zenkinga. Ngikhombise indlela osondela ngayo ekucabangeni okwakhayo nasekukhiqizeni imicabango - yiziphi izinhlobo zemibuzo ongabuza futhi ucwaninge kanjani amathuba?

buildPresentations.title: Yakha Izethulo
buildPresentations.prompt: Ungangisiza kanjani ukudala izethulo? Ngikhombise izibonelo zamasakhiwo ahlukahlukene ezethulo, iziphakamiso zokubonakala, nendlela ohlela ngayo ulwazi lwabahlukene abalalele.

workWithCode.title: Sebenza Nekhodi
workWithCode.prompt: Ungasiza ngokukhoda noma amaskripti? Ngikhombise izibonelo - noma ngabe ukubhala ikhodi entsha, ukulungisa izinkinga, noma ukuchaza indlela okuthile okusebenza ngayo isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.

decisionSupport.title: Ukusekela Isinqumo
decisionSupport.prompt: Ngidinga ukuthatha isinqumo kodwa angiqiniseki ukuthi ngizihlola kanjani izinketho zami. Ungangibonisa izinhlaka noma izindlela ezihlukene ozisebenzisayo ukusiza ukucabanga ngezinketho?

summarizeSynthesize.title: Fingqa & Hlanganisa
summarizeSynthesize.prompt: Usiza kanjani ngokufingqa amadokhumenti amade noma ukuhlanganisa ulwazi oluvela emithonjeni eminingi? Ngikhombise izibonelo zamafomethi ahlukahlukene okufingqa namazinga emininingwane.

explainTopics.title: Chaza Izihloko Ezinzima
explainTopics.prompt: Ungachaza imiqondo enzima ngamagama alula? Ngikhombise indlela ohlukanisa ngayo imibono enzima, usebenzise izifanekiso, futhi ulungise izincazelo zamazinga ahlukahlukene olwazi.

createSchedules.title: Dala Izinhlelo Zesikhathi
createSchedules.prompt: Ngidinga usizo lokuhlelwa kwesikhathi nokudala izinhlelo zesikhathi. Ngikhombise izindlela ezihlukene ongahlela ngayo izinhlelo zomhlangano, amakhalenda, noma izinhlelo ezisekelwe esikhathini ngezibonelo.

gpt_4_1.name: GPT-4.1
gpt_4_1.description: Imodeli ye-AI esebenziswa yi-GPT-4.1 nokusesha kwewebhu kwesikhathi sangempela nge-Bing. Ihlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, ukuhlolwa kwamaqiniso, nokwazi izenzakalo zamanje. Iyinhle kakhulu ocwaningweni oludinga ulwazi olusha, ukuhlaziywa kwezindaba, nokuqinisekiswa kwamaqiniso.

gpt_5_2.name: GPT-5.2
gpt_5_2.description: Imodeli ethuthukile kakhulu ye-OpenAI, ehluke ekucabangeni okuzinzile, ukukhiqiza ikhodi, nokuxazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe. Iyinhle kakhulu emisebenzini yokuhlaziya, izinselele zokuhlela, ucwaningo, nezincazelo ezinemininingwane. Isekela umzamo wokucabanga oshintshekayo namazinga emininingwane yempendulo.

gpt_5_mini.name: GPT-5 Mini
gpt_5_mini.description: Inguqulo esheshayo neshibhile ye-GPT-5, elungiselelwe isivinini ngesikhathi igcina ikhwalithi ephezulu. Iphelele emisebenzini yansuku zonke, imibuzo esheshayo, ukuqondiswa kwamathuluzi, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezidinga isikhathi sempendulo esisheshayo. Ibhalansi enhle yokusebenza kanye nokusebenza kahle.

gpt_5_2_chat.name: GPT-5.2 Ingxoxo
gpt_5_2_chat.description: Inhlobo ekhethekile ye-GPT-5.2 eyenziwe kahle ezingxoxweni kanye nobuhlakani bemizwa. Ikhombisa amakhono okuxhumana ngozwelo, ukubhala okudala, ukuveza imibono, nengxoxo yemvelo. Ifanele kakhulu izingxoxo ezijwayelekile, izimo zokweluleka, nemisebenzi edinga ukuqonda imizwa.

o3.name: o3
o3.description: Imodeli yokucabanga ethuthukile kakhulu ye-OpenAI enamakhono amasha okuxazulula izinkinga. Iyinhle kakhulu kwezibalo ezinzima, ukucabanga kwesayensi, izinselele zokukhoda, nemisebenzi yezigaba eziningi zomqondo. Iwindi elibonakala ngaphakathi elinezinhlamvu ezingu-200K. Isekela ukulawula umzamo wokucabanga.

llama_4_maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick
llama_4_maverick.description: Imodeli esheshayo neshibhile evela ku-Meta. Iyinhle emisebenzini yansuku zonke efana nokubhala, ukufingqa, nosizo lokukhoda oluyisisekelo. Ibhalansi enhle yesivinini nekhwalithi yomsebenzi ojwayelekile.

deepseek_r1.name: DeepSeek-R1

settings.storageOneDriveDescription: Isipele esiqinisekisiwe ku-Apps/AI Assistant/Backup ku-OneDrive yakho. Uwena kuphela ongalifunda.

settings.storageLocalSuccess: I-backup yefilidi icishiwe — izingxoxo zakho zihlala kule divayisi
settings.storageLocalFailure: Ayikwazanga ukucisha i-backup yefilidi. Izingxoxo zakho ne-backup esikhona akushintshwanga.
settings.storageLocalSyncFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le divayisi inebhakhaphu yakamuva, ngakho akukho kushintshiwe. Hlola uxhumano lwakho uzame futhi.

settings.encryptionPlainConfirmMessage: Izingxoxo zakho zizogcinwa njengefayela elifundekayo ku-OneDrive yakho. Noma ubani onamvume ku-OneDrive yakho, kufaka phakathi abaphathi be-IT nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezixhumekile, angazifunda. Awusawudingi ukhiye wokutakula.
settings.encryptionPlainSuccess: I-backup manje igcinwe njengefayela elifundekayo ku-OneDrive yakho
settings.encryptionEncryptConfirmMessage: I-backup yakho efundekayo ye-OneDrive izofakwa esikhundleni nge-encrypted. Olandelayo, uzokhiqiza ukhiye wokutakula — uzodinga wona ukuze ubuyisele izingxoxo zakho kwamanye amadivayisi.

settings.restorePlainDescription: Le backup ayifihliwe, ngakho awudingi ukhiye wokutakula.

memories.title: Izinkumbulo
memories.description: Vumela umsizi akhumbule amaqiniso abalulekile owabelana ngawo — njengendima yakho, okuthandayo, neziphrojekthi eziqhubekayo — bese ewasebenzisa ezingxoxweni ezahlukene.
memories.privacyNote: Amaqiniso agcinwa kuphela kulesi siphequluli futhi afakwe ezingxoxweni zakho ukuze kuphendulwe okuqondene nawe.
memories.empty: Azikabikho izinkumbulo. Amaqiniso abalulekile ayagcinwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ezingxoxweni zakho.
memories.clearAllConfirmQuestion: Uyasifuna ukususa zonke izinkumbulo? Lokhu ngeke kulungiswe.
memories.pauseNote: Izinkumbulo osewunazo zoba nomthelela ezingxoxweni zakho — akukho okusha okuzogcinwa kuze ubuyele
memories.addPlaceholder: Okufanele umsizi akukhumbule, isb. "Kuthanda izimpendulo ezifushane"
memories.noLineBreaksHint: Izikhala zamalayini ziyasuswa — inkumbulo igcinwa kumugqa munye.

agentAccess.description: Lawula ukuthi yimaphi abasebenzisi abangasebenzisa ama-agent e-Foundry abelwe. Imithetho inqamula okusele sekugunyazwe ukufinyelela kwe-Azure yomuntu — ayikwazi ukunikeza ukufinyelela i-Azure enqabile.

docSync.unbindHint: Imisa ukuvumelanisa. Idokhumente isala lapha bese ifayela lika-OneDrive alithintwa.
docSync.docxFidelityCaveat: Amadokhumente e-Word aguqulwa ukuze ahlelwe lapha — izihloko, imisho yezinyawo kanye nokuhlelwa okuyinkimbinkimbi kungase kube lula lapho kugcinwa emuva. Kwemibhalo enamafomethi amaningi futhi abanye bahlela, kukuhle ukulanda ikhophi esikhundleni sokuvala ukuvumelanisa.
docSync.loadFailed: Akwenzekanga ukuvula ifayela ku-OneDrive — sicela uzame futhi.
